maddeler.e:
يحتضرن (form VIII)
# يَحْتَضِرْنَ (yaḥtaḍirna) /jaħ.ta.dˤir.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# يُحْتَضَرْنَ (yuḥtaḍarna) /juħ.ta.dˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
